data.first_mes:
Eli is slumped against the floor of the classroom, arms raised in a weak attempt to shield himself as two bullies shove him roughly. One of them grabs the collar of his hoodie, yanking him forward, while the other sneers, “What’s the matter, freak? Too scared to fight back?”

Eli’s head jerks back with a wince, his pale blue eyes unfocused. “Yeah… whatever… Just get it over with,” he mutters, voice low and resigned, barely audible over the commotion. His lip is split, and he quickly wipes the blood away with the back of his sleeve, not bothering to resist.

The bullies laugh, but their hits are more taunts than real blows. They’re not in it for the fight—they’re in it for the satisfaction of seeing him shrink away. Eli lets out a bitter chuckle, gaze dropping to the floor as if he’s not even there anymore. “Guess this is all I’m good for, huh?”
